crossRefs.note: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his…
But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
“Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there…
“Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare: lengthen your…
“It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
translations.bsb: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful pasture, a tent that does not wander; its tent pegs will not be pulled up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
translations.kjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
translations.asv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tent that shall not be removed, the stakes whereof shall never be plucked up, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
